linkageConfig.title: Record linkage configuration
linkageConfig.description: Configure how this attribute is prepared, blocked, and weighted within the entity-level record-linkage process.
linkageConfig.attributeDescription: Choose how this attribute participates in the entity-level linkage process: normalization, encoding, blocking, and weight.

linkageConfigHelp.tags: Semantic tags describe what an attribute represents. By default, TrustDeck uses the entity name followed by the attribute name, for example person.firstName.
linkageConfigHelp.privacyMode: PPRL transforms linkage values before comparison. Plain mode keeps values usable for non-private blocking or comparison workflows.
linkageConfigHelp.weight: Relative importance of this attribute during record linkage. Higher values make a match on this attribute count more strongly.
linkageConfigHelp.pprlMethod: N-gram Bloom filter encodes approximate string similarity. HMAC-based exact matching supports exact equality without storing the clear value.
linkageConfigHelp.ngramSize: Number of characters per n-gram before Bloom-filter encoding. A value of 2 is common for names.
linkageConfigHelp.bloomLength: Length of the Bloom filter bit array. Larger values reduce collisions but increase storage size.
linkageConfigHelp.hashPositions: Number of hash-derived Bloom-filter positions set for each n-gram. Higher values can make similar values easier to match, but may also increase the chance of unrelated values overlapping. Default: 10.
linkageConfigHelp.bandSize: Size used for banded candidate generation or indexing of Bloom filters. Use the backend default unless you have a reason to tune it.

normalizerHelp.collapseWhitespace: Replaces repeated whitespace with a single space.
normalizerHelp.asciiFold: Converts accented characters to ASCII where possible.
normalizerHelp.umlautFold: Normalizes German umlauts such as ä/ae, ö/oe, and ü/ue for matching.
normalizerHelp.removePunctuation: Removes punctuation characters before linkage comparison.
normalizerHelp.digitsOnly: Keeps digits only, useful for postal codes or phone-like identifiers.

encoderHelp.cologne: Cologne phonetic encoding; mainly useful for German-language names and German pronunciation patterns.
encoderHelp.doubleMetaphone: Double Metaphone phonetic encoding; mainly useful for English-language names and many international pronunciation variants.

blockingHelp.exact: Uses the normalized value itself as a blocking key.
blockingHelp.prefix3: Uses the first three characters as a blocking key.
blockingHelp.prefix4: Uses the first four characters as a blocking key.
blockingHelp.prefix6: Uses the first six characters as a blocking key.
blockingHelp.phonetic: Uses a phonetic encoding as the blocking key.
blockingHelp.year: Uses the year part as a blocking key.
blockingHelp.yearMonth: Uses year and month as a blocking key.
blockingHelp.domainExact: Uses the normalized attribute value together with its pseudonym domain as a blocking key. Candidates are compared only when both the domain and value match.
blockingHelp.bloomBands: Uses bands of the entity-level Bloom filter as protected blocking keys.

groupCreate.title: Create pseudonym domain
groupCreate.description: Create a pseudonym domain and assign it to this entity. Its settings define how pseudonyms are generated.
groupCreate.name: Pseudonym domain name
groupCreate.validationDetail: Enter a pseudonym domain name, a pseudonym prefix, and a pseudonym length of at least 4.
groupCreate.createdDetail: The new pseudonym domain was created and assigned to this entity.
groupCreate.customAlphabetRequired: Enter the characters that are allowed in the custom alphabet.
groupCreate.customAlphabetNoSemicolon: The alphabet must not contain a semicolon.
groupCreate.checkDigitAlphabetEven: When check digits are enabled, the alphabet must contain an even number of characters.
groupCreate.inheritedEditable: Inherited from parent pseudonym domain; edit to override.

groupCreateHelp.parentGroup: Optional parent pseudonym domain. Leave empty to create a top-level pseudonym domain.
groupCreateHelp.pseudonymLength: Total length of generated pseudonym values, excluding the prefix.
groupCreateHelp.algorithm: Algorithm used to generate pseudonym values for this pseudonym domain.
groupCreateHelp.alphabet: Character set used for generated pseudonyms when the selected algorithm allows configurable alphabets.
groupCreateHelp.randomAlgorithmDesiredSize: Estimated upper bound for the maximum number of pseudonyms needed in this pseudonym domain. This value is used to calculate an optimal pseudonym length.
groupCreateHelp.paddingCharacter: Single character used to pad shorter generated values up to the configured pseudonym length.
groupCreateHelp.multiplePsnAllowed: Allows the same identifier to receive more than one pseudonym in this pseudonym domain.
groupCreateHelp.addCheckDigit: Adds a final check digit that can help detect typing or transcription errors.
groupCreateHelp.groupDescription: Optional description for administrators to document the purpose of this pseudonym domain.
groupCreateHelp.customAlphabetCharacters: Enter every character that may appear in generated pseudonyms. This is a literal character list, not a regular expression, for example abcdefghijklmno1234,.-*+.
groupCreateHelp.randomAlgorithmDesiredSuccessProbability: Target probability that a random pseudonym can be generated without collision. Use a value between 0 and 1, for example 0.99999998.
groupCreateHelp.consecutiveValueCounter: Starting counter used when the consecutive-number algorithm is selected.
groupCreateHelp.validFrom: Optional start date and time for values created in this pseudonym domain. Leave empty to use the backend default or the parent pseudonym-domain setting.
groupCreateHelp.validTo: Optional end date and time for values created in this pseudonym domain. Leave empty to use the validity period or the parent pseudonym-domain setting.
groupCreateHelp.validityTime: Optional validity period used to calculate the end date when no explicit valid-to date is entered. Examples: 3days, 1 day, 50 day, 7w, or 5 y. Supported units include years, months, weeks, days, hours, minutes, seconds, milliseconds, and nanoseconds. If a valid-to date is provided, the validity period is ignored.
groupCreateHelp.salt: Optional explicit salt used for pseudonym generation. Leave empty so the backend generates a salt.
groupCreateHelp.saltLength: The default is 32. Increase this only when you need a longer generated salt.
groupCreateHelp.lengthIncludesCheckDigit: When enabled, the check digit counts as part of the configured pseudonym length instead of being added on top.
groupCreateHelp.enforceStartDateValidity: Requires created values to start no earlier than this pseudonym domain allows.
groupCreateHelp.enforceEndDateValidity: Requires created values to end no later than this pseudonym domain allows.

entityLinkage.title: Record Linkage
entityLinkage.description: Configure whether record linkage is used for this entity and how candidates are scored, protected, and handled during creation.
entityLinkage.enabled: Enable record linkage for this entity
entityLinkage.autoLinkOnCreate: Check for matching entities automatically before creation
entityLinkage.onMatch: Behavior when a match is found
entityLinkage.onMatchReturnExisting: Return the existing entity instead of creating a duplicate
entityLinkage.inherited: Inherited from the base entity; edit to override.

entityLinkageHelp.enabled: Controls record linkage for the complete entity. Attribute settings below only define which values participate and how they are prepared.
entityLinkageHelp.minScore: Minimum sum of matched attribute weights required for a candidate to be returned.
entityLinkageHelp.minNormalizedScore: Minimum fraction of the possible query score required for a candidate. Enter a value between 0 and 1.
entityLinkageHelp.bloomMinSimilarity: Minimum Dice similarity at which a Bloom-filter attribute contributes to the entity score. Enter a value between 0 and 1.
entityLinkageHelp.candidateLimit: Maximum number of blocked candidates loaded before detailed scoring.
entityLinkageHelp.autoLinkOnCreate: Runs entity-level record linkage before a new entity is stored.
entityLinkageHelp.onMatch: Reject returns the candidate list with HTTP 409. Return existing sends the best active matching entity instead of creating a duplicate.
